title: Actress Eva Marie Saint, who won an Oscar for 'On the Waterfront,' dies at 102
summary: Saint won an Oscar for her portrayal of Edie, a Catholic schoolgirl whose longshoreman brother is murdered. She went on to star in Alfred Hitchcock's North by Northwest.
contentText:
On the Waterfront was Eva Marie Saint's first film job after years of theater and TV.'/> Saint won an Oscar for her portrayal of Edie, a Catholic schoolgirl whose longshoreman brother is murdered. She went on to star in Alfred Hitchcock's North by Northwest.
